name: Aetherseed
description: An invented floating crystal seed with two articulated crescent vanes and a violet tuft. No real-world anatomy.

core.description: Teal faceted teardrop core with the same single cream square eye and dark outline.

left_vane.description: The copper-gold crescent on screen left, with its small round attachment hub.

right_vane.description: The copper-gold crescent on screen right, with its attachment.

tail.description: The short violet two-lobed tuft and its small copper collar below the core.

landmarks.eye: Center of the cream square eye
landmarks.left_tip: Topmost visible tip of the left copper crescent
landmarks.right_tip: Topmost visible tip of the right copper crescent
landmarks.tail_tip: Tip of the longer violet tail lobe
landmarks.left_root: Center of the left copper circular hub
landmarks.core_left: Visible teal core just adjacent to the left hub
landmarks.right_root: Copper vane root beside the right side of the core
landmarks.core_right: Teal core beside the right vane root

hover.intent: A smooth six-frame floating idle cycle with individually articulated copper vanes and a lagging tail. Preserve all part sizes and the selected design.
poses: Neutral middle height; left crescent slightly lowered, right crescent slightly raised, tuft hangs left.
Rise one logical cell; both crescents rotate gently upward at their hubs; tuft lags below.
Highest point two logical cells up; crescents at their upper sweep; tuft curls gently right.
Return to middle height; crescents begin a downward sweep; tuft follows with a short delay.
Lowest point two logical cells down; crescents at their lower sweep; tuft bends gently left.
Rise toward middle height; crescents recover toward frame zero and tuft trails, ready for seamless wrap.
